_comment: Focused mutation audit of src/lib/nostr.ts — NIP-46 session helpers, pubkey formatting, localStorage read/write.
_ignore_comment: Stryker copies the project into each sandbox and does NOT honor .gitignore. Exclude large generated/cache dirs — especially the 34k-file pnpm content store, which otherwise bloats every sandbox copy and can trip ENFILE (system file-table overflow) under FD load. None are needed to run the vitest unit suite.
